title: Fission Raises $10 Million for Tokenized Fund Liquidity
why_it_matters: The financing targets a persistent market-structure gap: tokenized fund interests can settle digitally while investors may still face conventional redemption constraints.
caption:
RWA WIRE // NEWS

Fission Raises $10 Million for Tokenized Fund Liquidity

Fission closed a $10 million Series A led by Pantera Capital to expand liquidity capacity for eligible investors in supported tokenized funds.
